entities.name: Revival Trance
entities.description: A Final Fantasy VI-based Commander deck centered on self-mill and reviving creatures, themed on the World of Ruin.

entities.name: Limit Break
entities.description: A Final Fantasy VII-based Commander deck centered on equipment and creatures with power 7 or greater, referencing the planet and lifestream.

entities.name: Counter Blitz
entities.description: A Final Fantasy X-based Commander deck centered on adding counters, referencing Spira.

entities.name: Scions & Spellcraft
entities.description: A Final Fantasy XIV-based Commander deck centered on noncreature spells, themed on the Shadowbringers expansion and referencing Eorzea and Norvrandt.

entities.name: Terra, Herald of Hope
entities.description: Face commander of the Revival Trance deck.

entities.name: Tidus, Yuna's Guardian
entities.description: Face commander of the Counter Blitz deck.

entities.name: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed
entities.description: Face commander of the Scions & Spellcraft deck.

entities.name: Sephiroth, Fallen Hero
entities.description: A character featured among the new cards of the Limit Break deck.

events.summary: Four Final Fantasy Commander decks are released alongside the Final Fantasy set on June 13, 2025.
events.quote: Four Final Fantasy Commander decks were released together with Final Fantasy on June 13, 2025.
